title: Dependency allowlist (.a2dlc/deps.allow.json, versioned in the repo)
description: The dependencies an agent may add or change in the repo's manifests, per ecosystem (config.supply_chain.allowlist_file). A dependency not listed here is a dependency_not_allowed escalation. The file is versioned and reviewed like any source: a change to it is a human-owned path (config.protected_paths).

versions.description: Optional version range in the ecosystem's syntax. Absent: any version.
